priority_items.title: MHL hosts first Pacific WIM ExCom 25 (Loss & Damage)
priority_items.summary: WIM Executive Committee meeting in Majuro 14–18 Sep; first Pacific sitting; PINA attributes venue to COP31 Australia–Pacific Partnership. Daily 07:00 UTC incorrectly tagged MHL as quiet.

priority_items.title: Fiji FiTI MoU — first PIC fisheries-transparency commitment
priority_items.summary: Fisheries Minister Bainivalu signed FiTI Standard MoU in Rome at FAO COFI37; framed as stock assessment, access-agreement leverage, and IUU.

priority_items.title: Fiji launches first MSME climate parametric insurance
priority_items.summary: Tower Insurance Fiji product with UNCDF/ADB/PICAP; AUS and NZ MFAT in the donor stack. Triggers and take-up unpublished.

priority_items.title: MV Matui: VMSA legal track and NCL SAR assist
priority_items.summary: Toll band unchanged. Named VMSA official: not certified >30 pax, skipped inspection, possible manslaughter, EPIRB not activated. AP: NCL JRCC coordinating search; missing=37 is NCL figure.

priority_items.title: Wale opens Pacific climate conference in Honiara
priority_items.summary: Fifth Pacific Ocean Pacific Climate Change Conference hosted in Solomon Islands for the first time; 1.5°C and Pre-COP31/COP31 coordination.
